serverConfig.title: Local Server Configuration
serverConfig.maxTasksTooltip: After starting the transcoding queue, all unfinished tasks will be queued, and the foremost tasks will run continuously. The number of concurrently running tasks is controlled by this setting.
serverConfig.maxTasksTooltipWithLimit: After starting the transcoding queue, all unfinished tasks will be queued, and the foremost tasks will run continuously. The number of concurrently running tasks is controlled by this setting (Your user level supports a maximum of {limit} concurrent tasks).
serverConfig.preserveTasksTooltip: If the transcoding service exits unexpectedly, unfinished tasks during transcoding will be automatically restored to the task list the next time it runs.
serverConfig.ffmpegPathTooltip: The rules for valid paths depend on the operating system. If left blank, FFBox will automatically check the FFmpeg location based on the OS.

addTasks.title: Add Tasks
addTasks.browserDropHint: The web version cannot drag files into the text box. Please drag files directly into the task list to upload. 😊
addTasks.electronInputHint:
This input box is only for directly controlling the server to add tasks.
If you need to process local files, please select 'Task' -> 'Add Tasks (Select Files)' from the menu.

serverUserConfig.title: Local Server User Configuration
serverUserConfig.adminTooltip: Only in local mode can you log in with an empty account. An empty account is an administrator.
serverUserConfig.levelTooltip: Determines the range of functions available to the user. A number greater than the server's own level means that the full range of functions supported by the server can be used. This feature is currently useless.
